items.question: Is ScanDish really free?
items.answer: Yes. Every feature is free for your restaurant. There is no subscription, no credit card and no hidden charge for menu edits or QR downloads.

items.question: Do I need any technical skills?
items.answer: No. You sign up with your email, fill in your restaurant details and add menu items. The menu preview updates as you type.

items.question: How do customers see my menu?
items.answer: Every restaurant gets a unique link and a QR code. Guests scan the code and your menu opens instantly on their phone — no app to install.

items.question: How fast do menu changes appear?
items.answer: Instantly. The moment you save a price, photo or availability change, the public menu shows the new version. The same QR code keeps working.

items.question: Can I use my own logo in the QR code?
items.answer: Yes. Your logo sits in the centre of the code while the surrounding pattern stays clear, so it still scans reliably with a normal phone camera.

items.question: Can I order printed QR stands and posters?
items.answer: Printed table stands, posters and stickers are coming soon. Until then you can download your QR code as PNG or SVG and use the print-ready layout.

pages.title: About ScanDish — Digital Menus for Small Restaurants
pages.description: ScanDish helps small restaurants, cafes and food stalls create digital menus, share them with a QR code and update them instantly. Free to use.

hero.title: Menus that keep up with your kitchen
hero.subtitle: We build simple digital menus and QR codes so small restaurants, cafes and food stalls can share their menu from a phone or laptop — no printing needed.

textblock.title: Why we started ScanDish
textblock.body: Updating a printed menu means reprints, wasted paper and prices that are out of date the moment they change. ScanDish was built for small kitchens that need something faster: create your menu, share one QR code, and edit items anytime from your phone or laptop. Sold-out dishes can be hidden in seconds, prices stay current, and guests see a clean, mobile-first menu right after scanning. It is free to use, because a small food corner should not need a budget to look professional.

pages.title: ScanDish Services: Digital Menus & QR Codes
pages.description: See how ScanDish builds your digital menu and QR code: what each service solves, how setup works, and answers to common questions. Free to use.

hero.title: Digital menus and QR codes, explained
hero.subtitle: Two simple services that replace printed menus for good: a digital menu you can update in seconds, and a QR code that opens it on any phone. Both are free.

features.title: What each service solves
features.subtitle: Built for small restaurants, cafes and food stalls that want a modern menu without extra hassle.

items.title: Digital menu creation
items.description: No more reprinting when a dish changes. Edit items, prices and photos from your phone or laptop and the menu updates instantly.

items.title: QR code generator
items.description: Every menu gets its own QR code with your logo in the centre. Download it as PNG or SVG and put it on tables, walls or stickers.

items.title: Manage from anywhere
items.description: Add a category, mark a dish sold out or change a price while service is running. No designer or printer needed.

items.title: Clear veg and sold-out tags
items.description: Guests instantly see veg and non-veg tags and sold-out items, so there are fewer questions for your staff.

items.title: Instant mobile menu
items.description: The public menu opens fast after a scan, with a sticky category bar and large tap targets that work on small screens.

items.title: Support when you need it
items.description: Reach our team by email or WhatsApp straight from your dashboard or the public menu page.

items.title: Sign up for your account
items.description: Create your restaurant account with email and password. Only you can see and edit your own menu.

items.title: Set up your menu
items.description: Add your restaurant name, logo and starting categories, then fill in items with name, description and price. Photos and veg tags are optional extras.

items.title: Get your link and QR code
items.description: Your menu gets a clean public link and a matching QR code. Choose colours and corner style, then download PNG or SVG.

items.title: Place and update
items.description: Put the QR code on tables or walls. From then on, every change you make shows up the next time a guest scans.

items.question: Do I need a printed menu at all?
items.answer: No. Guests scan the QR code and read your menu on their phone. Many restaurants keep one or two printed copies as a backup, but you never need them for updates.

items.question: Can I change my menu after the QR code is printed?
items.answer: Yes. The QR code only points to your menu link, so you can change items, prices and availability any time and the same code keeps working.

items.question: Will the QR code with my logo still scan?
items.answer: Yes. Your logo sits in the centre of the code while the surrounding pattern stays clear, so it scans reliably with a normal phone camera.

items.question: What can I do from my phone?
items.answer: Everything in your dashboard: add categories, edit items, mark dishes as sold out and download a new QR code. A laptop works the same way if you prefer a bigger screen.

items.question: Does ScanDish cost anything?
items.answer: No. Every feature is free, including QR downloads and unlimited menu updates. There is no card, no trial and no hidden charge.

items.question: Do you handle online orders or payments?
items.answer: Not yet. ScanDish is focused on digital menus and QR codes today, with room to grow into ordering and payments later.
